clauses.title: Service Levels
clauses.text: BrightCloud warrants 99.9% monthly uptime, with service credits of 10% of monthly fees for each 0.1% below the SLA.

clauses.title: Limitation of Liability
clauses.text: Each party's aggregate liability shall not exceed two times (2x) the fees paid by Customer in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

clauses.title: Data Protection
clauses.text: BrightCloud maintains SOC 2 Type II certification and processes personal data in accordance with the GDPR. A Data Processing Addendum is incorporated by reference.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach with thirty (30) days written notice and opportunity to cure.

risk_findings.risk: Liability cap is symmetric and within industry norm
